Needs changes before merge.

The picked seam has a separate check for Control and Wear compensation. The new tests pass. No code defect was found in this review.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:347`: Complete the required heavy-lane validation and record the results in the PR body. The body lists only the quick gate and clippy. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches every heavy target in `motion` and `app` (241 planned steps). Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Name the lanes and their results in the body. Fix any failures before the PR becomes ready. Current upstream [AGENTS.md:628-636](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/878d4101a/AGENTS.md#L628-L636) requires these results. The quick gate does not run the ignored heavy tests.

### Results merged with main

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3350`. No GitHub runner was used.

- PR head: `bc1c6428b7071d740fd19725df24c4d9106a261f`.
- Main: `878d4101a`. The trial merge was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 145 steps passed, 0 failed, 41.1 minutes. The gate built the motion and mapped app test targets with `--no-run`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed, 4 minutes 44 seconds.
- Heavy lanes: `motion` and `app` were planned but not run. The PR body gives no result for them. They are not a pass.
- Light lane: not run.

### Extra suites run

No extra fixture or importer suite applies. The diff changes no test data, fixture, golden, importer, kernel, or UI file. The quick gate ran both changed integration suites and the motion unit tests. There are no moved goldens to compare.

### Safety mutations

Each guard was disabled only in the local review tree. Each source file was restored before the green check. The tracked tree is clean.

| Disabled guard | Test | Red result | Restored result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Collinear first and last cuts | `a_compensated_pick_on_a_sharp_corner_is_refused_by_name_not_moved` | 1 failed, exit 101 | 1 passed, exit 0 |
| Part vertex / parallel edge | `machining2d::contour_comp_pick::tests::a_straight_centre_chord_over_a_part_vertex_is_refused_by_name` | 1 failed, exit 101 | 1 passed, exit 0 |

The first mutation lost the named start-point refusal. The existing square-offset check still refused Control. The second mutation accepted the synthetic part-vertex seam. These were test assertion failures, not build failures.

### Quick-gate suite results

143 suite steps: 1722 tests passed; 66 tests ignored. Ignored tests are not counted as passed.
